texts.en: The [infiltrated_country_species.GetAdj] hive mind has discovered our influence. Just as we were ready to activate our assimilated nodal centers, we found ourselves cut off from the rest of their hive. Having quickly dismantled our missions, we must declare Operation [from.GetName] a failure. The [infiltrated_country_species.GetClass] population is now on high alert for any outside interference.
